tools.title: What the AI can do
tools.description: While writing a step's message, the AI can use these tools. It only uses what the instruction asks for, citing the exact name.
tools.footer: Tools work on every sequence, with nothing to turn on. In a test they only simulate: no field or tag changes.

checkAvailability.name: See open times
checkAvailability.description: Checks the schedule and returns some open times to offer the contact.
checkAvailability.example: Use the check_availability tool to see open times and offer the contact 3 options.

listContactFields.name: Read fields
listContactFields.description: Reads the contact's custom fields, with their current values.
listContactFields.example: Use the list_contact_fields tool to read the contact's fields before writing the message.

setContactField.name: Save field
setContactField.description: Creates or updates a custom field on the contact.
setContactField.example: Use the set_contact_field tool to save the reason for missing in the "missed_reason" field.

removeContactField.name: Delete field
removeContactField.description: Deletes a custom field from the contact.
removeContactField.example: Use the remove_contact_field tool to delete the "time_preference" field.

listTags.name: Read tags
listTags.example: Use the list_tags tool to see the conversation's tags before setting the tone.

addTag.name: Add tag
addTag.example: Use the add_tag tool to add the "wants-to-rebook" tag to the conversation.

removeTag.name: Remove tag
removeTag.description: Removes a tag from the conversation.
removeTag.example: Use the remove_tag tool to remove the "awaiting-rebooking" tag from the conversation.

illustration.message: Hi, Carla! We missed you today. Would you like to book another time?

intro.title: Follow-up that runs on its own
intro.description: Marked that someone attended or missed? The conversation gets the right messages at the right time, without anyone having to remember.

steps.title: Messages in steps
steps.description: Each step goes out some time after the previous one, within the hours you choose. You write the text, or ask the AI to write it.

triggers.title: A follow-up for each outcome
triggers.description: Thank those who attended and win back those who missed, with separate sequences. Enrollment can be automatic, and the sequence stops if the person replies.

start.title: Ready to start?
start.description: Create your first sequence in a few minutes, from scratch or from a ready-made template.
